setup.run: echo '=== MagnusCI Demo Pipeline ===' && echo 'Stage: setup' && echo 'Timestamp:' $(date -u +%H:%M:%S) && echo 'Node: '$(hostname) && sleep 1 && echo 'Setup complete.'

test.run: echo 'Stage: test' && echo 'Timestamp:' $(date -u +%H:%M:%S) && sleep 2 && echo 'Running unit tests...' && echo '  PASS src/queue.test.js' && echo '  PASS src/dag.test.js' && echo '  PASS src/webhook.test.js' && echo 'Tests: 12 passed, 0 failed' && echo 'Test stage complete.'

lint.run: echo 'Stage: lint' && echo 'Timestamp:' $(date -u +%H:%M:%S) && sleep 2 && echo 'Running ESLint...' && echo '  Checked 18 source files' && echo '  0 errors, 0 warnings' && echo 'Lint stage complete.'

package.run: echo 'Stage: package' && echo 'Timestamp:' $(date -u +%H:%M:%S) && sleep 1 && echo 'Packaging build artifacts...' && echo '  dist/index.js         42 KB' && echo '  dist/worker.js        18 KB' && echo 'Package stage complete.'
